peer_identity.arc_label: Two-headed Emperor who employs Aghora as mercenary—generations after Othon's Emperor
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Two-headed or conjoined-headed figure. Has authority over entire Imperial Fleet. Politically pragmatic—accepted Aghora's terms after capability demonstration. Asked directly if she intended to kill him and take his place. Very thin record; primarily a contracting patron.
peer_identity.rationale: Distinct from the Othon-era Emperor by both biology ('two-headed') and timeline. Accepts Aghora's solo contract terms after she demonstrates power by purging the court. Cautious pragmatist rather than emotionally attached patron.
